classificationSettings.risk.title: When is a student at risk?
classificationSettings.risk.hint: Configure direct rules. There are no points or hidden weighting.
classificationSettings.risk.highSummary: A student is High risk when any rule below is true
classificationSettings.risk.behaviourRul: More than {count} concerning behaviour records within the last {days} days.
classificationSettings.risk.busRule: More than {count} bus exceptions within the last {days} days.
classificationSettings.risk.mediumRule: They have 1–{behaviour} concerning behaviours or 1–{bus} bus exceptions within {days} days, and no High-risk rule applies.
classificationSettings.risk.noneRule: No recent concerning behaviour or bus exceptions, and Canvas average is not below the High-risk threshold.
classificationSettings.risk.behaviourCou: High risk when concerning behaviours exceed
classificationSettings.risk.busCount: High risk when bus exceptions exceed
classificationSettings.risk.canvasBelow: High risk when Canvas average is below (%)
classificationSettings.commendation.hint: Configure direct recognition rules. There is no score or weighting.
classificationSettings.commendation.rule: They have at least {positive} positive behaviour records within {days} days OR a Canvas average of at least {canvas}%, AND they have no more than {bus} bus exceptions during those {days} days.
classificationSettings.saveError: Unable to save the rules. Check the values and try again.
